## POST `/api/2.58/antivirus/targets/icap/scanners`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates one or more antivirus ICAP scanners within a target. Either the `target_ids` or `target_names` parameter is required to specify the parent target, but they cannot be used together. Scanner names are system-generated.

| `target_ids` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the specified unique target IDs. Enter multiple target IDs in comma-separated format. Either the `target_ids` or `target_names` parameter is required, but they cannot be used together. |
| `target_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the specified target names. Enter multiple target names in comma-separated format, for example, `name01,name02`. |

|---|---|---|

| `uri` | string | The URI of the ICAP scanner, in the format `icap[s]://<hostname>[:<port>][/<service>]`. If the port is not specified, it defaults to `1344` for `icap://` and `11344` for `icaps://`. If specified without a protocol,… |

## PATCH `/api/2.58/antivirus/targets/icap/scanners`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modifies one or more antivirus ICAP scanners. The `names` parameter is required. Disabling the last active scanner in a target may cause an outage because unscanned files cannot be read. To override this protection, set `allow_no_active_scanner=true`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `allow_no_active_scanner` | query | boolean |  | Set to `true` to allow the operation to proceed even if it leaves the target with no active (enabled) scanners. Defaults to `false`. |
| `context_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the context specified. If specified, the context names must be an array of size 1, and the single element must be the name of an array in the same fleet or the name of the fleet itself. If not… |
| `ids` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of unique resource IDs. At least one resource must match each specified ID, otherwise an error is returned. This parameter is required if ids or names is not provided, but it cannot be used… |
| `names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique names specified. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. For example, `name01,name02`. If there is not at least one resource that matches each of the elements of `names`,… |

**Request body** (required): `AntivirusIcapScannerPatch`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | If set to `true`, the ICAP scanner is enabled. If set to `false`, the scanner is disabled. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `AntivirusIcapScannerResponse`
